hebrewText: וּ/בַ/חַגִּ֣ים וּ/בַ/מּוֹעֲדִ֗ים תִּהְיֶ֤ה הַ/מִּנְחָה֙ אֵיפָ֤ה לַ/פָּר֙ וְ/אֵיפָ֣ה לָ/אַ֔יִל וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֖ים מַתַּ֣ת יָד֑/וֹ וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָ/אֵיפָֽה

tokens.bdb: a festival, or a victim therefor

properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally ayear; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand)
tokens.kjv: appointed (sign, time), (place of, solemn) assembly, congregation, (set, solemn) feast, (appointed, due) season, solemn(-ity), synogogue, (set) time (appointed).

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: a donation; euphemistically, tribute; specifically a sacrificial offering (usually bloodless and voluntary)
